items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: That's a Ware. Her name is Ware. I came from the Ware family.

ctx.x: Well, she looks kind of Indian to me.

Wait, I mean, that's my great...that's my mother's...my mother's mother's mother. Yeah, I see. She's kind of Indian to me. Yeah, she is. That's the old eternity. That's a Ware. Her name is Ware. I came from the Ware family. They're scattered all over Louisiana. Is that a photograph or a drawing? I don't know what it is. It looks like a photograph from way back. Old, old town. Way back. It must be old...I know it's better than a hundred years old.
You better copy it. It's gonna fade, you know. Yeah. That's an interesting face. She says she's half Indian or something like that?
